scope: The main connected historic market of Tabriz, including covered retail rows, timber shopfronts, characteristic domed halls and the mapped open caravanserais.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: State Party survey identifies interconnected market rows, named roofed chambers and open caravanserais. South Amir chamber rises to 13.5 m, North Amir to 11 m, Boyuk Sherbaflar to 9 m and Haj Safar Ali to 14 m. The major carpet timche is two-storey.
The connected center covers 26.3722 ha. Kabood Mosque and Sorkhab are distinct sites.
Conservation project records the integrated bazaar form and brick roofs, vaults, domes and covered crossroad forms.
